about: vel-MC-ACT: the owner-steps lint tuning set. Neutral synthetic questions only (the repository is public: no real Mission Control text, not even with names stripped), modelled on the shapes of real items. positive: an owner step written into a kind=question, which closes with the question when the owner answers it; each names text the finding must carry. negative: an ordinary decision or status question, including every false positive the reviews of PR #60 named. r4 (PR #60): shapes from a counts-and-shapes-only run over the real store; how the owner answers and what the agent does are not owner steps, and an option label is read for owner-addressed phrases only.
